theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_structure_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl P)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.PurelyUnrectifiable (m + 1) A → (∃ S : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), A ⊆ ⋃ j, S j ∧ ∀ j, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) (S j) < ∞) → ∃ Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P, ∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' A) = 0
